data_output.description: data.py remains unchanged and encode(splits) returns each split as (features, labels, users), where features has five columns in canonical order user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday and uses the existing train-fitted offsets.

model_input.description: model.py receives the existing integer feature matrix with shape (n_rows, 5); columns 0 and 1 index separate user and video embedding tables, and columns 2 through 4 index additive tab, hour, and weekday weights. It returns one finite raw logit per input row and preserves the existing step/state/load_state interfaces.
